title: mlip-cpu-bench-2026: equation-of-state benchmark of five universal MLIPs on 70 solids (2-core CPU)
description: Third-order Birch-Murnaghan E(V) fits for CHGNet-r2SCAN-2026.9 (matgl), PET-MAD-s (upet), MACE-MP-0 medium, Prophet-OAME-MBD and FlashCart-MAD on 70 solids (44 TSB16 cubic + 26 LEJ14 elements), CPU only, 2 cores, 3000 MB RSS cap. Code, per-solid results, logs and charts. Model weights are not included and keep their own licences; reference data from TSB16 and LEJ14.
